query: Microsoft Azure revenue Q2 2026 fiscal year

output.content: Microsoft did not disclose an absolute dollar figure for Azure alone in fiscal Q2 2026; it reported that **Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 39% year over year** (38% in constant currency) in the quarter ended **December 31, 2025**. [[1]]
